ideons.name: Hunting Tendril
ideons.text: Gains 1 attack each owner command. Attacks the weakest Ally directly; without Allies, moves left. At the left edge inflicts Poison 2 each command. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They grow +1 attack each command and hunt Allies; without Allies they drift left to inflict Poison 2. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting old tendrils. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.
